title: Check the right endpoint
text: At $$x=1$$ the series is the alternating series of $$\frac{{\left(-1\right)}^n}{\ln\left(2n\right)}$$, which converges by the alternating series test.

title: Check the left endpoint
text: At $$x=-1$$ the terms are $$\frac{1}{\ln\left(2n\right)}$$. Since $$\frac{1}{\ln\left(2n\right)}>\frac{1}{2n}$$, the series diverges by comparison with the harmonic series. So the interval is (-1,1].
